name: opendm
description: Open-source, self-hosted alternative to ManyChat-style Instagram comment-to-DM automation, on Cloudflare Workers.
author: SS Enterprises

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:browser

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin dashboard (/admin). Pick a long one.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random string (32+ chars): signs the login cookie and encrypts stored tokens. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

VERIFY_TOKEN.description: Any string you choose; paste the same value into Meta's webhook 'Verify token' field.

INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET.description: Instagram app secret from your Meta app (Instagram Login > API setup). Used to verify webhook signatures.
